title: SEKA Spear RDC Frameset official store page
notes: Global store listing for the Spear RDC Frameset at USD 2,801 in eight finishes (Opal White, Chronos, Thorian Purple, Nighthawk Blue, Solar Bronze, Meteor Pink, Shadow Black, Ultra White) and sizes XS–XL including MR and LR; most options were out of stock. Package: frame, fork and seatpost, Rapier integrated handlebar, frameset and Rapier accessories, and a Spear aero bottle-cage set; bare frame weight printed as 685 g ±35 g. Global-store price and stock do not establish mainland checkout, delivery or dealer packages.
